evidence_boundary: Existing unknown-unit lists are already exposed. Decisions below follow representation/sampling requirements, not reserve-dependent frequency cutoffs; no reserve counts choose a fix.

fitting.codebook: Development units/frequencies/position classes only. Calibration and reserve may not fit unit inventories, rank maps, spelling normalizers, abbreviation rules or generator rates.
fitting.codebook_identity: Hash the exact selected development stream and target inventory. Hold mappings fixed across reserve views. Diagnostic whole-reserve representation maps are quarantined and cannot initialize claim fits.
fitting.read_vs_fit: Reserves may be read for this requested provenance/coverage diagnosis. Reading does not authorize fitting.

length.allowed_repetition: Words already repeated in the original source remain repeated. Independent Monte Carlo draws may reuse the fixed development corpus; uncertainty is conditional on that corpus, not independent-corpus replication.
length.comparison: A complete family comparison needs all preregistered candidates supported at the same declared geometry. A smaller common-size experiment is a separately frozen diagnostic, never a rescue of this cell.
length.failure: SOURCE_TOO_SHORT / UNSUPPORTED_AT_SIZE before generator/model invocation. Never CANNOT_MIMIC_BASICS, ELIMINATED or a passing control.
length.generative_families: G5 native copy history and G6 reuse of their own table are mechanisms, not external source padding. Preserve G5 seed-line exclusion and native generation; stop/censor only at predeclared boundaries.
length.primary_pool: Development only for fitting/generation. Calibration is for declared tuning/runtime/scale controls, reserve for evaluation. Do not merge partitions after observing shortages.
length.prohibited: No cyclic wrap, padding, within-manuscript reuse of source positions, stitching unrelated works, silently changing source or shortening only one candidate family.
length.real_Latin: Native-page reserve remains a five-page control. Development vocabulary may pool explicitly listed earlier sources for codebook estimation, but generated source sequences may not stitch their manuscripts/pages without documented continuity.
length.required_budget: Use original word slots, including unknown positions, not readable-word count alone. A fixed missingness mask can be applied only after allocating all original slots.
length.selection: Uniform over all eligible start positions within the admitted development runs, without inspecting generated or reserve outcomes.
length.support: Need at least one contiguous same-work run covering the entire requested slot budget. Aggregate counts over different works or gaps are not enough.

prior_exposure: Preserve earlier maps made from full reserve source distributions as diagnostic-only. Earlier Macer last40% mechanism controls overlap later calibration/reserve partitions; no historically untouched claim is made.
tier: sandbox policy settled; not claim FREEZE

unknown.adjacency: No dropping/repacking unknown words, joining neighbors across them, promoting later words to line-start, or using partial known letters as a complete word.
unknown.conditional: Supported-slot diagnostics can be reported separately, with exact coverage and masks. Conditional held scoring requires its own later frozen estimand and support gate; it cannot certify full-source G2 survival.
unknown.conversions: No accent stripping, NFC/NFD policy change, digit completion, mark merging, silent expansion, unknown-to-common-glyph assignment, reserve reranking or post hoc source additions in this cut.
unknown.improvement: Any inventory expansion must come from independently selected development data or a new externally justified alphabet/prior, with a new cut and a newly reserved test source. Current reserves are not recycled as new training.
unknown.primary: Any original unknown or out-of-development unit => full-transfer NOT_ESTIMABLE. Never interpret as a production-family elimination.
unknown.semantics: Literal digits/signs/diacritics are identified by Unicode representation and provenance only; no automatic numeral, abbreviation or meaning is inferred.
unknown.view: Retain every original word/line slot. A word containing any unseen unit becomes one None barrier; retain its raw written units/offsets in a separate provenance ledger.
